items.name: Pulmapelipäivät 2024
items.information:
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
The schedule may be subject to change, so if you're leaving the venue during the day, make sure to return at least 30 minutes before your scheduled events.


Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Aikataulu voi muuttua, joten jos poistut kisapaikalta päivän aikana, palaa vähintään 30 minuuttia ennen lajejasi.

items.name: Contigo Peru Lima 2024
items.information:
Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ContigoPeruLima2024#43911-registro-registration) para obtener información detallada.
Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)
Debido a cuestiones de aforo, los participantes deben evitar asistir con invitados.

See the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ContigoPeruLima2024#43911-registro-registration) tab for detailed information.
Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)
Due to capacity limitations, participants should avoid attending with guests.

items.name: Sri Lankan Nationals 2024

venue.name: [Hotel P.T. Gardens, Biyagama, Colombo](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RFExyeJzdq1UBzbo7)
venue.address: Hotel P.T. Gardens, Walgama, 540A4 Samurdhi Mawatha, Biyagama, Sri Lanka

items.information:
* Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late. You can refer "Schedule" tab to see the starting time of each event.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time, please bring a valid proof of identity (**NIC/Passport/Postal ID/Driving License**)
If you still don't have any of the above mentioned identifications, bring a colour photograph of yourself certified by your school principal or a justice of peace.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the new competitor tutorial session at 08:30 AM on day 2 (check [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SriLankanNationals2024#competition-schedule)).
* All participants are expected to volunteer for the event when they are not participating. The roles could be of a judge, runner, or a scrambler, depending upon the situation.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) as the Heartland Regional Championship of 2024.

Competitors from Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota are eligible for the title of Heartland Champion.
